dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. How do I get to the waterfall?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. ˈhaʊ duː aɪ ˈɡɛt tə ðə ˈwɔːtərfɔːl?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Take this path. It goes through the forest.
dialogue.reading: ˈteɪk ðɪs ˈpæθ. ɪt ˈɡoʊz θruː ðə ˈfɔːrɪst.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Walk along the river for about twenty minutes. Then go across the old wooden bridge.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɔːk əˈlɔːŋ ðə ˈrɪvər fər əˈbaʊt ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts. ˈðɛn ˈɡoʊ əˈkrɔːs ði ˈoʊld ˈwʊdən ˈbrɪdʒ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Across the bridge. Is the walk difficult?
dialogue.reading: əˈkrɔːs ðə ˈbrɪdʒ. ɪz ðə ˈwɔːk ˈdɪfɪkəlt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: A little. After the bridge, the path goes over a small hill.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɪtəl. ˈæftər ðə ˈbrɪdʒ, ðə ˈpæθ ˈɡoʊz ˈoʊvər ə ˈsmɔːl ˈhɪl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And the waterfall is after the hill?
dialogue.reading: ənd ðə ˈwɔːtərfɔːl ɪz ˈæftər ðə ˈhɪl?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. It's in a beautiful valley. You can swim there, but don't go into the water after rain.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ɪts ɪn ə ˈbjuːtəfəl ˈvæli. juː kən ˈswɪm ˈðɛr, bʌt ˈdoʊnt ˈɡoʊ ɪntə ðə ˈwɔːtər ˈæftər ˈreɪn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: The river gets very fast, and it's dangerous. Be careful!
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈrɪvər ˈɡɛts ˈvɛri ˈfæst, ənd ɪts ˈdeɪndʒərəs. bi ˈkɛrfəl!
